sentences.en: The day pupils have different schedules compared to boarding students.
sentences.zh: 日间学生和寄宿生的课程表不同。

sentences.en: Most day pupils come from nearby towns and cities.
sentences.zh: 大多数日间学生来自附近的城镇或城市。

sentences.en: The school has both day pupils and boarders, creating a diverse community.
sentences.zh: 这所学校既有日间学生也有寄宿生，形成了一个多元化的社区。

senses.zh: [短语]只是白天来上课的学生;
